title: Satay Veggie Noodle Stir-Fry
subtitle: with Snow Peas and Peanuts
description: We're nuts about satay! With tender veg and springy egg noodles tossed in a lip-smacking peanut sauce, you will be too. What's more, it's on the table in record time.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Thinly slice the capsicum. Trim the stems from the snow peas, removing the strings from one side. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Peel the carrot, then shred using a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater. Juice half the lime, then cut the remaining half into wedges.

Cook noodles: Cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 3 mins. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking. Put the peanut butter, 2 tsp lime juice, 1 tbs soy sauce, 2 tsp honey and 1 tbs water in a small saucepan and stir over low heat until the peanut butter is melted and the mixture is warmed through. Remove from the heat.

Cook omelette: Whisk 1 egg in a bowl, then season with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Add the egg mixture and swirl to coat the base of the pan. Cook for 1 min or until just set, then loosely roll up the omelette in the pan. Remove from the pan and cool slightly, then cut into strips.

Stir-fry veggies: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the same pan over high heat. Stir-fry the capsicum, snow peas and garlic for 1-2 mins until tender but still with crunch. Add the carrot and stir-fry for a further 30 secs or until softened.

Serve up: Add the noodles and 1 tbs soy sauce to the veggies and stir-fry for 2-3 mins until combined and warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the noodle stir-fry among bowls, then top with the omelette strips and peanuts. Drizzle over the satay sauce (see Kitchen 101), serve with the lime wedges and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Add an extra splash of water if your sauce has thickened too much.
